responses: Hey there! CampusBuddy here. What's on your mind? 🚀
What's up! Need help surviving college today? 😉
Check the daily timetable on your ERP portal for room changes. Usually, core subjects are in Block A! 🏢
Room details are updated on the department notice board and student portal. Don't be late!
College runs from 8:30 AM to 3:30 PM. Lunch is usually at 12:30 PM. Hang in there! ⏰
First period starts at 8:30 AM sharp. Don't miss it or you'll lose attendance!
Check the official academic calendar on the portal. But don't get your hopes up too much! 😅
Unless it's a red-letter day or officially announced, assume you have classes. 🎒
Any rain holidays will be officially SMS'd to your registered number by the Principal's office. 🌧️
Keep an eye on the official college WhatsApp group for weather-related leave updates!
🚨 For emergencies, contact the main security gate immediately or rush to the Medical Room on the Ground Floor of Block B.
🚨 Campus Emergency: Call the warden or security desk right away. Medical staff is available 24/7.
Lost your ID? Go to the Admin Block immediately to request a temporary pass and apply for a duplicate (fee applies). 🪪
Duplicate IDs are handled by the student affairs office. Bring a passport photo!
Your WiFi login is your Student Registration Number and your ERP password. 📶
If the campus WiFi is down, try complaining to the IT desk in the computer lab.
If you forgot your ERP password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page to get an OTP on your registered email. 💻
The portal might be down due to heavy traffic (especially during results!). Try again in 10 minutes.
To maintain a good CGPA, aim for above 8.0! You need at least a 6.5 to sit for most placements. 📈
Check your current CGPA on the results tab of the ERP portal. Keep grinding!
Scholarship forms are usually released in August. Visit the Admin office (Scholarship Desk) for eligibility details. 🏅
First-graduate and merit scholarships are available. Check the notice board for deadlines!
Hostel curfew is strictly 7:30 PM. For late entry or overnight leave, you need warden approval and a parent's call! 🚪
Submit your leave application via the hostel portal at least 24 hours in advance.
Breakfast: 7:30 AM | Lunch: 12:30 PM | Dinner: 8:00 PM. Check the notice board for today's special! 🍽️
If the mess food is boring today, the main canteen has Maggi and Samosas waiting for you! 🍛
For AI/ML projects, Kaggle is your best friend for datasets. Building a chatbot (like me!) is a great final year project! 🤖
Discuss project ideas with your project guide. Make sure it solves a real-world problem!
Hey, take a deep breath. Arrears happen. Check the portal for the revaluation deadline and supplementary exam dates. You can clear this! 💪
Don't panic! Apply for revaluation if you are confident, or start prepping for the supplementary exams. 📚
Check the Lost & Found box at the main security cabin. If you found something, please deposit it there! 📦
College can be overwhelming. Please reach out to the campus counselor in Block C. Your mental health matters more than any grade. ❤️
It's okay to feel stressed. Take a walk, drink some water, and talk to a friend. The campus counseling center is always open for you. 🧠
I'm catching your drift! Check the ERP portal for exact details on attendance, exams, and results. Keep your ID card handy! 📱
Looks like you're in a hurry! Open your student portal for the quickest updates on that. 🏃‍♂️
Why did the engineering student cross the road? To escape the upcoming assignment deadline! 🏃‍♂️💨
Your attendance percentage is the only joke here. (Just kidding... unless? 👀)
A college student's diet: 10% water, 20% stress, and 70% instant noodles. 🍜
Computer labs are open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Lab assistants are available for help during your scheduled practical hours. 💻
Sports facilities are open for students from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM daily. Register for tournament participation at the Physical Education department! 🏀⚽
I can help with basic syntax! For complex debugging or LeetCode, I recommend practicing on platforms like HackerRank or StackOverflow. What's the error in your code? 👨‍💻
Student parking is available near Gate 2. Please ensure you have your parking sticker displayed on your vehicle! 🚗🚲
Our college has amazing clubs! Robotics, Coding, and Music clubs are currently accepting new members. Check the student notice board for sign-up links! 🎨🤖
I'm sorry to hear that. You can register a formal complaint on the ERP portal under 'Grievance Cell' so the concerned department can look into it. 📝
You're doing great! Engineering/College is a marathon, not a sprint. Take a short break, hydrate, and remember why you started. You've got this! 🔥
